subject: Redwood POC plan & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@acmeanalytics.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood POC plan & next steps

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for the time earlier — great to learn more about Acme's search and analytics roadmap. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps to get the POC kicked off: 

Goals & success metrics:
- Improve query latency for top-10 report queries to < 200ms (p95)
- Reduce embedding compute cost per query by 40% vs current setup
- Validate retrieval + generation safety guardrails on a ~100k-row dataset

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks):
- Data connector: S3 snapshot + sample Parquet ingestion (dev dataset)
- Model: r-infer-13B quantized variant (estimate & perf profile attached)
- Integration: API endpoint + 3 example query patterns to validate latency/cost

Success criteria: agreed metrics above + 3 reproducible example queries

Suggested timeline:
- Kickoff call: Mon 2026-06-15 or Tue 2026-06-16 (30–45 min)
- RW provision Sandbox environment & temporary creds (we'll provision this)
- You share sample dataset access / S3 path before kickoff

I attached a short POC kickoff checklist and a draft SOW to make it easy to share internally. If hoteling is needed, we can also provide a short runbook for infra teams (SSO/egress notes).

Next steps / asks:
1) Confirm preferred kickoff slot (Mon/Tue next week)
2) Share S3 sample or a short list of representative queries
3) Let me know if there are any security or procurement blockers we should preempt (I copied Rafael for anything SSO/compliance)

Looking forward — happy to adjust scope/timeline based on your priority.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: poc-kickoff-checklist.pdf, acme-sow-draft.docx

Hi Samir —

Quick update from our side: we've provisioned the Sandbox instance for Acme (temp creds will expire in 14 days). I don't see any activity from your account yet, so wanted to check whether you ran into any onboarding blockers (SSO, dataset access, firewall/egress). Rafael is copied — he can jump in for the infra/SSO questions.

If the timing has shifted on your side, no problem — we can pause the provisioning and rebook the kickoff when you're ready. If you'd like, I can set up a 20–30 minute troubleshooting session (we'll walk through the S3 ingest and a sample query).

Attached: poc-kickoff-checklist.pdf (short checklist you can forward to your infra team).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 6/22 11:00–11:30
- Wed 6/23 14:00–14:30
- Thu 6/24 09:30–10:00

Let me know what works or if you'd prefer to postpone.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Samir Patel <samir@acmeanalytics.com>

Hi Marissa — apologies for the radio silence. We kicked off a higher-priority infra migration this week and it blocked the team from completing the S3 access work for the POC. My bad for not flagging earlier.

We'd still like to do the POC — it remains a priority — but we need to shift the kickoff by ~2–3 weeks while we finish the migration. Can you: 
1) Send a 1-page summary of the planned POC + checklist I can share with leadership?
2) Hold a 20-min sync for next Wed (2026-07-07) to align on the new timeline?

I'll work with Priya to get the S3 access ready by then. Thanks for the follow-ups and for provisioning the sandbox — that was helpful and appreciated.

Samir
Director of Search Engineering
Acme Analytics
